page_title: BAR 3-3 GRA | Barcelona v Granada CF 11/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+8' Barcelona players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
90+5' Substitution. Raul Torrente (Granada CF) has come on for Gerard Gumbau.
90+2' Marc Guiu (Barcelona) latches onto a lofted pass on the edge of the six-yard box, but powers a header just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Granada CF will have a goal kick.
90' 8 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' We are about to witness a subsitution. Marc Guiu (Barcelona) for Pedri.
84' Alexander Medina has decided to substitute Facundo Pellistri and he is replaced by Kamil Jozwiak (Granada CF).
84' That's the end of the game for Myrto Uzuni, who is replaced by Matias Arezo (Granada CF).
84' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias shows a yellow card to Antonio Puertas (Granada CF) for his unsportsmanlike behavior after the match has ended.
82' The resulting set piece from Granada CF is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

82' A loose ball is pounced on by Myrto Uzuni (Granada CF) inside the box. He immediately fires in a shot towards the top right corner, but Marc-Andre ter Stegen is alert and makes a comfortable save. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Granada CF.
80' 3 - 3 Goal! Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) finds some space for a shot from the edge of the box and his attempt goes low inside the right post. Fantastic finish.
79' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) has a goal ruled out for offside!
78' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
78' Ignasi Miquel (Granada CF) has tested the patience of referee Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
75' Here is a change. Joao Cancelo is going off and Xavi gives the last tactical orders to Raphinha (Barcelona).
75' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Oscar Melendo as he is replaced by Jose Callejon (Granada CF).
72' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) launches a cross from the corner, but Augusto Batalla is alert to thwart the effort.

71' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players. The ball goes out for a corner. Barcelona can continue in their attacking effort.
71' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) works the corner short.
71' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. Good work from Barcelona as they win a corner.
70' 62:38 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
70' The Barcelona players are exchanging some short passes.
69' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Granada CF.
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Andreas Christensen leaves the pitch and Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) comes on.

66' 2 - 3 It's a goal! Ignasi Miquel (Granada CF) makes it 2:3. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from Faitout Maouassa and planted his close-range header into the left side of the goal. Marc-Andre ter Stegen was helpless.
65' Referee Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias has finally had enough of Xavi and brandishes a yellow card at him!

64' 2 - 2 Goal! Great link up play between Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) and Ilkay Gundogan gives the former a clear sight of goal on the edge of the box. He doesn't disappoint and beats the keeper in the bottom left corner. 2:2.
63' Barcelona keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
61' 1 - 2 Goal! Facundo Pellistri (Granada CF) scores after an assist by Myrto Uzuni that allowed him to tap in the ball into an empty net. The score is 1:2.

60' Inigo Martinez (Barcelona) times his run and jump perfectly to get on the end of the resulting corner, but the ball comes off the top of his head and goes miles over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Granada CF.
60' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) will take a corner kick.

60' Pedri (Barcelona) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Barcelona will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
58' The foul by Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) was seen by Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.

57' A pass into the box finds Facundo Pellistri (Granada CF) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the right side of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Marc-Andre ter Stegen denies him.
56' Pedri (Barcelona) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
55' Barcelona hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.

52' What a big chance! Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Granada CF will have a goal kick.
52' The ball is cleared after Facundo Pellistri (Granada CF) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
51' Great teamplay by Granada CF as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
47' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
47' The resulting corner from Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) is cleared.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Augusto Batalla intercepts the ball.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.

43' 1 - 1 It's a goal! Ricard Sanchez (Granada CF) scores with a brilliant shot into the top right corner after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Facundo Pellistri. The score is now 1:1.
43' The resulting corner from Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) is cleared by the defence.
42' The corner is swung in but Barcelona can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. The referee signals a corner kick to Barcelona.

41' What a great touch by Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the right side of the goal, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending. The ball is out of play. Barcelona win a corner kick.
41' Faitout Maouassa (Granada CF) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.

40' Miguel Rubio (Granada CF) leaps high deep inside the box to meet a beautiful cross from the resultant free kick. He glances a header goalwards, but it goes narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Barcelona will have a goal kick.
39' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows his whistle as Andreas Christensen (Barcelona) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack. A free kick is awarded to Granada CF.
38' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.

35' Pau Cubarsi (Barcelona) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. It's a free kick to Granada CF, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
35' Faitout Maouassa (Granada CF) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. The ball has crossed the sideline. Granada CF are taking a throw-in.
34' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias shows a yellow card to Sergio Ruiz (Granada CF) for his blatant foul.
28' Barcelona seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
25' Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
25' An attempted cross from Facundo Pellistri (Granada CF) is cleared. The referee blows his whistle, Granada CF are awarded a corner kick.
23' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is out of play. Barcelona will take a throw-in.

20' Oscar Melendo (Granada CF) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the bottom left corner that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance.

19' Faitout Maouassa (Granada CF) shows off his skills with a mazy run to the edge of the box and then fires in a disappointing shot that flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Barcelona.
17' Granada CF enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
14' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Joao Cancelo plays it into the box, and Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) gets on the end of the cross to put it into the back of the net. 1:0.
14' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Granada CF will have a goal kick.
13' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
10' Facundo Pellistri (Granada CF) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is out of play. Granada CF will have a throw-in.
9' A defence splitting pass into the box is almost received by Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona), but Augusto Batalla is quick enough and comes off his line to intercept the pass.
7' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) is penalised for a foul. Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias had a clear view and blows his whistle.
5' The Barcelona players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
3' Gerard Gumbau (Granada CF) receives a pass and fires a shot in from long range, but it's blocked.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Barcelona will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias.
